coreMemory.english: n. a sentence used to ask for information；v. to ask about or doubt something
coreMemory.structure: ask a question /æsk ə ˈkwestʃən/（提问）；answer a question /ænsɚ ə ˈkwestʃən/（回答问题）；question whether /ˈkwestʃən wɛðɚ/（质疑是否……）；good question /ɡʊd ˈkwestʃən/（好问题）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use question with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of question in context；❌ translate question word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “ask a question”

commonErrors.wrong: use question with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈkwestʃən wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of question in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈkwestʃən ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “ask a question”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz æsk ə ˈkwestʃən/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
